title: Adds holds for books that are out
reason: A member can wait in line for a book that is out. Holds take the place of the old reservations.

parts.name: Holds tab
parts.note: A new tab of the member page: see the holds, place one, pause it or cancel it.

parts.name: Routes
parts.note: The web routes that the tab calls.

parts.name: Night job
parts.note: Each night the copies that came back go to the first member in line. The old run of reservations is gone.

notes.title: The reservation run is gone
notes.text: It mailed each member whose reserved book came back, and archived the old reservations.

parts.name: Desk screen
parts.note: The desk sees which copies wait on the ready shelf, and for whom.

parts.name: Hold service
parts.note: The rules of holds, in one place for the routes, the night run and the desk.

notes.title: Read the date and the opening hours
Hold back on a closed day
notes.text: The run stops when the library is closed, unless a test date is set.

notes.title: Select the returned copies
notes.text: Copies that came back while a member waits for their book, locked for this run.

notes.title: Pass over a member who left
notes.text: The hold is cancelled, and the copy goes to the next member on a later run.

notes.title: Set the pickup day
notes.text: Seven open days of the branch, then the copy goes on the ready shelf.

notes.title: Send the pickup notice
notes.text: When the mail fails, the desk calls the member instead.

notes.title: Give back what the run did

parts.name: Tables
parts.note: The tables of holds and of their history. The reservation tables and their client type are gone.

notes.title: No client type for reservations
notes.text: The generated client drops the reservation, since the server sends holds now.

diagrams.title: How one night run offers returned copies
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  start["Read the date and the opening hours"]
  open{"Library open today?"}
  closed(["Return: closed today"])
  pick["Select the returned copies"]
  each{"More copies?"}
  member{"Card still active?"}
  passed["Pass the hold over"]
  ready["Set the pickup day"]
  notice["Send the pickup notice"]
  done(["Return what the run did"])
  start --> open
  open -- no --> closed
  open -- yes --> pick
  pick --> each
  each -- yes --> member
  member -- no --> passed
  member -- yes --> ready
  ready --> notice
  notice -- ok --> each
  notice -- error --> each
  passed --> each
  each -- no --> done

diagrams.title: The night run, message by message
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant J as Night job
  participant S as Hold service
  participant T as Tables
  J->>S: offer_returned_copies(limit=50)
  S->>T: select the returned copies
  T-->>S: rows
  loop each returned copy
    S->>T: set the pickup day
    S->>S: send the notice
  end
  S-->>J: checked, offered, passed over

diagrams.title: The states of one hold
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  [*] --> waiting: place
  waiting --> paused: pause
  paused --> waiting: resume
  waiting --> ready: copy offered
  ready --> waiting: missed pickup
